about: Where the numbers of a record come from when that is not simply the paper it cites: a curve produced in another paper, a table that belongs to one of several papers in a release, a curve computed by the maintainers of a compilation, or values taken from a web page. Read by one reader from the papers' LaTeX sources and the records' own text on 2026-10-20; 'stated' means a sentence says it, 'inferred' means the reader concluded it. Records not listed here plot a curve from the paper they cite (834 were checked by reading the paper's figure caption or text; 469 were not individually checked).

kinds.curve-produced-elsewhere: The cited paper reproduces this curve; it was produced in {primary}.
kinds.citation-lists-both-papers: The data release lists several papers; this quantity belongs to {primary}.
kinds.values-via-secondary-source: Some of the values come from {primary}, not from the cited paper.
kinds.computed-by-compilation-maintainers: Not the plotted curve of the cited paper: the maintainers of the comparison-data compilation computed it from the simulation's public catalogue. The cited paper describes the simulation only.
kinds.author-web-page-via-compilation: The numbers come from the author's web page, through the comparison-data compilation, not from a table in the cited paper.
kinds.evaluated-from-published-fit-by-code: Generated by the compilation's software from the published fit, not a table in the cited paper.
kinds.digitized-by-compilation: Read from the paper's figure by the compilation with WebPlotDigitizer, although the record's tier says published-table.
